## Notes

Coffee Stain Studios, published by Coffee Stain Publishing; early access 2019-03-19; 1.0 on PC 2024-09-10; PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S 2025-11-04; single-player and co-op; FICSIT tiers completed by delivering crafted components; Space Elevator receives Project Assembly parts; 5.5 million copies by January 2024.
